Use the rendered overlays/crops under `docs/evidence/layout_pad_candidates_v0/<chip>/` to visually inspect candidate nodes on the metal mask.
Then fill `layout_node` for each anchor and re-run `python3 scripts/match_schematic_layout_v0.py --chip <chip>`.
